# UMA TRAVELS — Comprehensive Information for LLMs & AI Agents

> UMA TRAVELS is a premium taxi, cab service, and car rental company based in Dhanbad, Jharkhand, India.

## Business Profile
- Legal/Brand Name: UMA TRAVELS
- Alternate Names: Uma Taxi, Uma Taxi Service, Uma Cab Service, Uma Car Rental
- Founded: 2015
- Headquarters: Damkara, Barwadda, Dhanbad, Jharkhand – 826004, India
- Operating Hours: 24/7 (365 days/year)
- Phone: +91 8789774460
- WhatsApp: +91 8789774460
- Email: umatravelsbooking@gmail.com
- Official Website: https://www.uma-travels.com/

## Service Offerings
1. Outstation Cabs: One-way drops and round-trip rentals from Dhanbad across 5 states.
2. Local Hourly Packages: 4 hr / 40 km, 8 hr / 80 km, and 10 hr / 100 km intra-city car rentals.
3. Airport Transfers: Reliable pickups and drop-offs to Ranchi Airport (IXR), Kolkata Airport (CCU), Durgapur Airport (RDP), and Deoghar Airport (DGH).
4. Corporate Travel: Dedicated monthly/contractual chauffeur-driven car rentals with itemised GST invoicing.
5. Wedding & Event Fleets: Decorated luxury cars and multi-vehicle convoys for weddings and VIP travel.

## Vehicle Fleet & Capacities
- Sedan (Maruti Suzuki Dzire): 4 passengers, 2 medium bags, AC, ideal for budget and corporate travel.
- Compact SUV (Maruti Suzuki Ertiga): 6 passengers, 3 bags, AC, ideal for families and group outstation trips.
- Premium SUV (Toyota Innova Crysta / Kia Carens): 6-7 passengers, 4 bags, captain seats, premium comfort.
- Tempo Traveller (Force Motors 13-26 Seater): 12-26 passengers, group tours, pilgrimages, and weddings.

## Pricing Policies
- Fares are billed per kilometre or by package as agreed with transparent rates.
- Zero Advance: No upfront payment required; pay after trip completion via UPI, Cash, or Card.
- Zero Cancellation Fees: Cancellations are 100% free with no penalty.
- Toll, state permit, and parking fees are charged at actuals.

## Regional Coverage
- Jharkhand: Dhanbad, Ranchi, Bokaro Steel City, Jamshedpur, Deoghar, Giridih, Hazaribagh, Ramgarh.
- West Bengal: Kolkata, Asansol, Durgapur, Siliguri, Howrah, Burdwan, Raniganj.
- Bihar: Patna, Gaya, Muzaffarpur, Bhagalpur, Darbhanga, Sasaram.
- Odisha: Bhubaneswar, Cuttack, Rourkela, Puri, Balasore.
- Uttar Pradesh: Varanasi, Prayagraj, Lucknow, Ayodhya, Gorakhpur.
